Episode 129: The Majesty of Murakan
Rushing from the Biment were Jiryong Rabus and Untiel, along with the wizards who had formed a relationship with them.
Rushing from the Jipel were Hwaryong Teo, Cheongryong Laramakua, and the wizards who received their power.
In total, four dragons and eight wizards looked up at the sky dyed with aura, the collapsed Heukwangsan Fortress, and Murakan with wide eyes.
In particular, all four dragons had experienced the heyday of Murakan.
The wizards felt the frantic heartbeats of the dragons they were riding on.
'The dragons... are they scared?!'
'This is the first time this has happened. Is this okay?'
Extreme tension.
The wizards couldn't help but feel tense as the dragons stiffened.

The fact that the guardian dragon of the recently revealed 12th generation of Runcandel was powerful was already well known to the public through incidents like the terrorist attack on Geomhwangseong.
At that time, Murakan had almost single-handedly defended the airspace.
Moreover, given the 12th generation's unconventional moves and the absence of martial prowess, it was only natural for wizards to have such misconceptions.
'Runcandel's 12th generation attacked Heukwangsan Fortress with their guardian dragon...'
'And they won!'
The wizards swallowed hard, thinking simultaneously.
'We knew they were regaining their strength, but have they already reached the level where they can take down Heukwangsan Fortress on their own?'
'The speed at which they're regaining their old power is extraordinary. Just a few years ago, they couldn't even compare to Sister Quicantel.'
Rabus and Untiel glanced at Murakan and coughed.
[Hmm, hmm! Ah, a friend of Soldelet, the ruler of Mount Murakan, the Black Dragon Murakan. We didn't expect to meet you here.]
[We didn't expect to see you here. How have you been, Great Black Dragon?]
Rabus and Untiel spoke with an air of formality.
They were dragons who had met Murakan during their preparatory period.
'Those are the dragons we met when we first saw Quicantel. They were also pretending to be polite back then.'
Murakan locked eyes with the two dragons.
To be precise, Murakan looked at Rabus and Untiel, who didn't dare to make eye contact with him.
Both dragons were among those who had been hit the hardest by Murakan in his prime.
[Rabus, Untiel. What brings you here?]
[We just came because we detected an unusual current from the Bise Kingdom.]
[It seems like there was a big fight. If it's not too much trouble, could you share the details with us... uh!]
Flutter-!
Before Untiel could finish speaking, Murakan flapped his wings once, powerfully.
The gesture, which could be compared to a person slamming their fist down, was a sign of displeasure among dragons.
[Lowly earth dragons, do you dare ask me, here and now, to tell you what happened?]
[No, brother. That's not it.]

[Murakan, it's a misunderstanding, a misunderstanding! We would never make such a demand of you. We're just asking if you could, perhaps, share the story with us... Of course, if you don't want to, there's nothing we can do about it.]

Their tone changed immediately. They had no choice but to feel embarrassed. If Murakan had regained all his former power, there would be no one in the world who could stop him. At least that's what the earth dragons believed.
To put it bluntly, in that case, Murakan could turn them into half-dead beings and kill all the wizards, and the empire would still be the one who had to be careful.
[Is that so? I've felt it since last time; it seems a lot of time has passed. The way my fellow dragons treat me is not as cautious as it used to be, and my displeasure grows day by day.]
Huuuung!
The spiritual energy that covered the sky began to grow thicker.
[And you two, especially, seem to be desperate for death.]
In an instant, blades made of spiritual energy sprang forth from the dark sky. Labus and Untiel bowed their heads frantically, terrified.
[Brother, it's not like that. We're sorry!]
[I made a mistake, let's calm down and talk!]
The dark blades effortlessly pierced through the protection shield they hastily deployed.
The earth dragons couldn't even react properly. If Murakan had intended to, he could have inflicted a fatal blow with this one strike.
From the beginning, the target of the spiritual energy blades was not the earth dragons, but the fire and azure dragons behind them.
Teo and Laramakuah quickly descended and rotated to dodge Murakan's blades.
But they didn't retaliate. They seemed to know how much trouble they could cause if they did.
The reason Murakan suddenly became so enraged was none other than:
Fire Dragon Teo.
He was a descendant of the Fire Dragon Kadoon of Kelliac Zipple and a dragon who had a connection with Murakan.
Murakan and Kadoon had never been on good terms, and just before the Holy Kingdom incident, Murakan had almost lost all his power due to Kadoon's ambush.
Now, to Murakan, fire dragons were a race he wanted to tear apart just by looking at them.
[Fire Dragon Teo. Didn't your king tell you? Never to meet me. And if you do, unfortunately, you must grit your teeth and run away as fast as you can.]
Spiritual energy blades formed again, and Teo, Laramakuah, and the wizards of Zipple barely managed to hide their bewildered thoughts.
'Was that tremendous energy we sensed just an hour ago really from that crazy black dragon...?'
Of course, that was a misunderstanding on Teo's part.
The power that destroyed Heukwang Mountain was not Murakan's aura, but Zephyrin's magic.
However, since the magic disappeared without a trace after Zephyrin left and exploded, there was no reason to think it wasn't Murakan's power.
'No matter how much, fighting Murakan, who has regained so much power to be this arrogant, is suicidal.'
'I thought the battle between Balkas and Amela would be decisive, but this situation is beyond my expectation. We need to retreat immediately!'
Like almost all dragons in the world, Teo and Laramakuia were also afraid of Murakan in his prime.
Especially Teo, who had a deeper fear because he had witnessed the other fire and red dragons suffer simply because of his relationship with Kadun.

"Answer me, Teo, and Laramakuia. Depending on how pleasing and reasonable your answer is, I will decide whether to annihilate you or just cripple you. And that answer will also affect the fate of the earth dragons."
"Big brother? Wh-why us? We didn't do anything wrong. Please don't do this."
"Yeah, we'll back off right away!"
Murakan didn't answer the earth dragons' desperate voices but glared at Teo and Laramakuia. The earth dragons didn't know what to do and just fluttered their wings.
All the dragons were trembling. Their eyes were filled with anxiety, and there was no trace of confidence.
'Wow, Murakan... I'm not used to this.'
For Jin, the Murakan who read adult magazines while scratching his thigh and was completely obsessed with strawberry pie was much more familiar.
When the grandeur of a thousand years ago stood out, he looked like a completely different being.
Even without showing definitive 'evidence' that he had regained all his old powers, Murakan was freezing the dragons of the Zipple and the Empire.
Even though the earth dragons might not know, Fire Dragon Teo and Azure Dragon Laramakuia were by no means low-ranking beings.
'Anyway, if they decide to stand up against us, it might be a headache.'
In fact, Murakan was tired.
Jin, as the only contractor who shared aura, was keenly aware of this fact.
Murakan had already used almost all of his power in his previous battle with Zephyrin.
Yet, the reason Murakan is so confident in scolding the dragons is simply because of his 'personality'.
Murakan had lived as the strongest being from the moment he was born for over 3,000 years.
Whether he had regained all his old powers or only regained 40% of them, or even if not a single one remained, Murakan couldn't even imagine having a different attitude from his prime.
The reason Jin didn't step forward even though he knew Murakan was tired was also similar.
He didn't want to scratch Murakan's pride. If the dragons attacked, he would fight alongside Murakan. Neither the Zipple nor the Empire could have a claim in the Bise Kingdom anyway.
On the other hand, Rune Kandel himself had just supported the Heukwang Group, so he had a claim.
'Even though it looks like those who came here not only think we supported the Heukwang Group but also mistakenly believe we destroyed them.'
While misunderstandings and tension were building, the Heukwang Group remained silent.
Perhaps it is more appropriate to say that they couldn't say anything.
Due to the explosion caused by Zephyrin just now, most of the captains and high-ranking officers were severely injured or still rescuing members, and Balkas was unconscious.
As the Black King's party, they had to be extremely cautious. They didn't know what would unfold if they rashly tried to clear up the misunderstanding.
Above all,
Balkas had passed command to Jin before losing consciousness.
So they had to stay still until Jin took action.
Jin quickly organized his thoughts and came to this conclusion:
'As long as the dragons of Ziphil and Bement retreat, I can somehow turn the situation in my favor.'
If only the dragons of Ziphil and Bement would just back off.
The reason why there was such a redundancy in the conclusion was that Jin still hadn't deeply 'experienced' Murakan's status among the dragons.
Although he had heard from all over the place that his guardian dragon was great in the past, it was an area that could not be fully felt unless they had spent a thousand years together.
In other words, the dragons of Ziphil could not even think of confronting Murakan.
"…Murakan, I apologize for unintentionally offending you. Teo and I will quickly retreat, so can you please forgive us just once?"
Laramakua said. Although the tone was calm, the answer was so humble that Jin was secretly surprised.
Of course,
Murakan had no intention of letting it slide so easily. The fact that the fire dragon had come to him made him even angrier.
Just as he was about to reply that he would only cripple them,
Jin spoke first.
"I accept! Dragons of Ziphil and Bement, return to your homeland immediately. Before my guardian dragon changes his mind."
At those words, the dragons of Ziphil and Bement looked down at Jin in surprise, and Murakan,
Immediately understood Jin's intention and regained his rationality. He realized that not calming his anger here would be no different from putting his contractor in danger.
The earth dragons continued rolling their eyes, and the fire and blue dragons met Jin's gaze.
Eventually, they had no choice but to answer like this.
"We are grateful to the great...contractor of the Black Dragon for clearing up the misunderstanding. We hope to meet again on better terms next time."
Laramakua's answer sounded like 'We will back off today but we won't forget this humiliation', but Jin smiled slyly.
"Thank you. Take care, everyone."
